Anti-Dandruff Hair Oil | DIY Recipe & Application Guide | Dr. Hansaji
Dandruff is not necessarily a sign of a dirty scalp. It can be associated with excess oil, rapid skin shedding and an overgrowth or altered activity of Malassezia, a yeast naturally found on the scalp. Scratching, excessive rubbing and leaving heavy oil on an already oily scalp may worsen irritation.
